data.rationale: The proposal gets the GitHub profile, top repo, and mail draft with discard right, but it omits the step of opening the blog in a new tab to read the latest post and closing the tab. It also lists followers, repo, stars, language and post as input parameters when they are extracted values, and it leaves out the blog URL, a real input. It adds a Users filter step that isn't in the true workflow, so an automation couldn't fetch the post title from this spec.
